description:
Pull the latest orders from connected fulfillment providers. Pass store_uuid to sync one store; omit it to sync all of your stores. Use to refresh orders that have not come through yet.

[#64e731]

store_uuid.description: Scope the sync to one store (omit for all stores).

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: sync_orders
